title: Common request headers
description: Headers shared by every synchronous API of Pending Template Updates. Header names are written in lowercase (HTTP header names are case-insensitive; lowercase is the HTTP/2 wire form).
$comment: Source: PRD RF-120, RNF-042, T-16 (REST /v1, RFC 9457, correlation-id propagated); DISENO 3.8.5 (API conventions: Idempotency-Key, correlation, authorization), S7 (e), 7.2 and RNF-017 (traceparent, W3C trace context). Authorization is provided by the platform and is out of scope (DESIGN_DOC 'deliberately left out'; DISENO 3.8.5): no authorization header is modelled. Audience: all. Residency: n/a (headers only).

correlationId.description: Correlation id propagated end to end (RF-120): taken from the request when present, otherwise generated by ms-experience-gateway for UI calls (DISENO 3.8.5); echoed in every response and in Problem Details; becomes EventEnvelope.correlationId of any message the call causes (DISENO 4.2). For a publish the root correlation id is the publishId (DISENO 7.2).

contentTypeJson.description: Content-Type of a JSON request or success response.

contentTypeProblem.description: Content-Type of an RFC 9457 Problem Details error body.

contentTypeEventStream.description: Content-Type / Accept of the SSE stream (DISENO S7 (e)).

retryAfter.description: Retry-After (RFC 9110): delay-seconds or HTTP-date. Mandatory on the 503 fallback of SX-01a (DISENO 4.8). Its value is operational (no number fixed in the documents).

lastEventId.description: Last-Event-ID of the SSE reconnection (DISENO S7 (e)): the id of the last notification received; the server resumes after it.

idempotencyKey.description: Idempotency-Key (DISENO 3.8.5, DEC-35): uuid generated by the client for each intended write. Same key + same body -> same effect and same response; same key + another body -> 409 idempotency-key-reuse. Creating operations derive the resource id from it (UUID v5: jobId of reverify, campaignId, runId, reportId); dead-tasks:retry uses it as requestId.
